༄༅/ /dbang bskur chos kyi sgo 'byed gcod kyi zhal gdams bzhugs so/ /

tei:div.tei:p: ༄༅/ /dbang bskur chos kyi sgo 'byed gcod kyi zhal gdams bzhugs so/ /

chos dbyings rnam dag spros bral mi dmigs nam mkha' la/ /smon lam byams brtse tshad med gzugs sku'i nyi ma brgya'i/ /dri med phan bde'i 'od kyis 'gro rnams lam bstan pa'i/ /rgyal ba rgyal sras chos rgyas bla ma'i zhabs la 'dud/ /bdud dang 'gal rkyen bar chad mi mthun phyogs/ /chos nyid rtogs pas lam du 'khyer byas nas/ /de yi don chen dngos grub thob byed pa'i/ / lam mchog mthar phyin gcod kyi zhal gdams bri/ / gcod kyi gdams pa 'di la don gsum/ /spyi khrid nyams khrid zhal gdams gsum du yod pa las/ spyi khrid sngon du song bas nyams khrid rkyang pa bya/ nyams khrid bskyangs pa'i zhal gdams sgo 'byed rnams bstan par bya'o/ /thog mar dbang bskur chos kyi sgo 'byed dang*/ sgrub thabs byin rlabs sgo 'byed/ rmi lam nyi zla sgo 'byed/ 'pho ba thar pa'i sgo 'byed/ bar do 'od gsal sgo 'byed/ gegs sel rten 'brel sgo 'byed/ bogs 'don yon tan sgo 'byed/ gzhan don 'phrin las sgo 'byed/ sgrub thabs khyad 'phags sgo 'byed dang bcu'o/ /dbang bskur chos kyi sgo 'byed ni/ ting nge 'dzin gyi dbang la brten nas chos sgo 'byed par byed de/ de la mtshan nyid dang ldan pa'i bla mas/ snod dang ldan pa'i slob ma rjes su gzung bar 'dod pas/ dben pa'i gnas su phyag dar byas/ bla bre dang logs yol bres la/ sku gsung thugs kyi rten bkram/ ras gtsang ma'i stegs bu'i khar me tog gi tshom bu lnga bkod/ mchod pa rnam pa lnga bshams/ gtor ma che ba gcig /'bring po bzhi dang lnga bshams/ tshogs kyi yo byad ci 'byor ba bshams la/ dbang zhu ba rnams phyi rol du khrus byas la sgo drung du gu gul gyi dud pas bdug /thun brdeg /bgegs bskrad la nang du btang ngo*/ /de nas mchod pa rnam lnga dbyangs su phul lo/ /bla mas 'di skad brjod de/ 'o na thugs la 'di ltar bzhag par zhu/ dus da res thub pa'i bstan pa rin po che 'di dang mjal/

rten mi lus gtsang ma thob/ dbang po sgo lnga tshang*/ rgyud la dad pa brtan po yod/ yul bla ma mtshan ldan dang mjal/ chos theg pa chen po bka' shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa'i dgongs pa/ bdud kyi gcod yul lta bu nyams su blang du yod pa 'di 'o skol rnams bsod nams bsags pa yin no/ / de lta bu'i gcod 'di nyams su len par byed pa la/ spyir pha rol tu phyin pa'i dgongs pa yin/ nang gsang sngags don gyi lta ba yang yin/ rnal 'byor bla na med pa'i rgyud kyi nyams len yang yin pas/ 'di'i ngo sprod 'bogs pa'i sngon du skyabs 'gro dang rgyud smin par byed cing*/ zab mo nyan pa'i snod du rung bar bya ba'i phyir dbang bskur dgos pas/ sngar thob na'ang shin tu legs/ sngar ma thob na'ang 'dir thob par byed pa yin no/ / de la cho ga'i sbyor ba/ dngos gzhi/ rjes rnam pa gsum du yod pa la sbyor ba la/ sngon du skyabs 'gro'i sdom pa dang sems bskyed 'bogs pa/ phyir bla ma la phyag 'tshal me tog gtor la rjes zlos bya'o/ /sangs rgyas chos dang 'phags pa'i tshogs rnams la/ /byang chub bar tu bdag ni skyabs su mchi/ /'khor ba'i sdug bsngal rgya mtsho las bsgral phyir/ /dkon mchog gsum gyis rjes su gzung du gsol/ /zhes lan gsum bya ba ni skyabs 'gro'i cho ga'o/ /sdom pa 'bogs pa ni/ rigs kyi bu khyed rnams so so thar pa'i rigs bdun las gang yang rung ba sdom pa dang*/ byang chub sems dpa'i bslab pa dang*/ rig 'dzin sngags kyi dam tshig la sngar brten nam/ da gzod brten par spro'am byas te/ spro lags zhes bya'o/ /de nas sdom pa gsum gyi cho ga blang ba ni/ slob dpon bdag la dgongs su gsol/ /'khor ba'i sdug bsngal bsgral bya'i phyir/ /mi dge spong ba'i tshul khrims dang*/ /dge ba chos sdud tshul khrims dang*/ /sems can don byed tshul khrims gsum/ /bdag gis rtag tu bzung bar bgyi/

/deng nas brtsams te mi btang zhing*/ /nus pa'i tshul gyis gzung bar bgyi/ /zhes lan gsum bya'o/ /de nas dbang zhu ba'i phyir gsol ba btab pa ni/ 'gro ba'i bla ma ston pa po/ /sdug bsngal rgya mtshor bying pa la/ /mgon po khyed ni dpal du byon// de ring bka' drin gnang du gsol/ /zhes lan gsum gyis gsol ba btab bo// de nas slob dpon gyis 'di skad bya/ 'o na thugs la 'di ltar bzhag par zhu/ slob ma rnams rjes su gzung ba'i phyir/ bdud kyi gcod yul ngo sprod 'debs pa'i sngon du/ snod du rung bar byed pa dang dbang bskur ba'i skabs yin pas/ de la gsum/ dbang thob pa'i phan yon/ ma thob pa'i nyes dmigs/ ji ltar bskur tshul dang gsum las/ dang po thob pa'i phan yon ni/ gnas skabs su gdams ngag zab mo nyan pa'i snod du rung ba/ nam mkha' sgo 'byed kyi ngo sprod 'debs su btub pa/ mthar thug sku bzhi ye shes lnga 'phrin las bzhi'i ngo bor sangs rgya ba yin te/ dpal de nyid 'dus pa las/ yongs su rdzogs pa'i dbang thob na/ /sangs rgyas go 'phang rgyang mi ring*/ /lag na rin chen thogs pa'i mi// longs spyod rgyang mi ring ba bzhin/ /zhes so/ /dbang ma thob pa'i nyes dmigs ni/ snod du mi rung bas gdams pa nyan par mi dbang*/ skal ba med pas ngo sprod gdab tu mi btub/ rjes gnang med pas nyams su blang mi rung ba'o/ / dus 'khor las/ dbang med pa la dngos grub med/ /bye ma btsir ba'i mar dang 'dra/ /des na dbang bskur dam pa yin/ /rab tu 'bad de blang bar bya/ /zhes so/ / ji ltar bskur tshul la gnyis/ snod du rung ba'i bum dbang bdun bskur ba dang*/ 'bras bu ye shes skye ba'i mchog dbang gsum bskur ba'o/ /dang po ni/ maṇ+ḍal gyi steng du pad+ma dmar po 'dab ma bzhi pa zhig bsam/ dbus kyi lte ba la ma cig lab sgron ngo bo bla ma la/ rnam pa rdo rje rigs kyi mkha' 'gro ma sku mdog mthing kha/

sku la dur khrod kyi rgyan drug gsol ba/ mi mgo'i do shal/ thod pa'i dbu rgyan mdzad pa/ phyag g.yas na gri gug /g.yon na thod pa bdud rtsis gang ba bsnams pa/ mchan khung g.yon pa na kha ṭ+wām̐ ga bsnams pa/ gdan mi ro'i steng na bzhugs pa/ zhal gcig phyag gnyis/ spyan gsum pa/ snyan cha rus pa'i war mig bcug pa/ zhabs g.yon brkyang ba g.yas bskum pa'i rting pa bha ga la gtad pa/ sku la me ri dang me dpung 'bar ba zhig tu bsgom/ de'i shar phyogs kyi 'dab ma la de bzhin rigs kyi mkha' 'gro ma sku mdog dkar mo gtso mo dang mtshungs pa/ lho'i 'dab ma la rin chen rigs kyi mkha' 'gro ser mo/ nub kyi 'dab ma la pad+ma rigs kyi mkha' 'gro dmar mo/ byang gi 'dab ma la las kyi rigs kyi mkha' 'gro ljang gu/ de thams cad rgyan dang phyag mtshan cha lugs bzhugs stangs gtso mo ltar bskyed/ de nas gtso mo'i bum pa bdud rtsis gang ba phyag tu bsnams pa khyed rang rnams kyi spyi bor bzhag par bsgoms la/ zhal nas tshig 'di skad gsung par sgoms shig / rdo rje mkha' 'gro'i chu yi dbang*/ /de ring khyed la bskur bar bya/ /sangs rgyas sku ni rab sgrub phyir/ /rdo rje mkha' 'gror khyed gyur cig /oṃ badz+ra ṭāk+ki ni a bhi ṣiñca hūṃ/ zhes pa slob dpon gyis brjod kyang ting nge 'dzin gyi gtso mos brjod par bsgoms la/ steng gi nam mkha' la brgyud pa'i bla ma/ yi dam dpa' bo mkha' 'gro thams cad bdud rtsi'i char 'bebs/ rol mo'i sgra sgrog /bkra shis kyi glu dbyangs len/ 'dod yon gyi mchod pa 'bul/ sku gsung thugs kyi byin gyis brlabs/ mchog thun mong gi dngos grub ster bar sgoms shig byas la/ rol mo'i sgra drag la thung ba 'ur tser sgrog /de rnams dbang lnga char la bya'o/ /des rdo rje mkha' 'gro chu'i dbang skur bas/ rnam par shes pa'i phung po rdo rje rigs kyi lha tshogs su gnas gyur to/

/nyon mongs pa zhe sdang me long ye shes su dag /'byung ba chu'i lha mo ma ma ki'i ngo bor dag pa'o/ /de nas lho'i 'dab ma'i steng na bzhugs pa'i rin chen mkha' 'gros/ rigs lnga'i dbu rgyan khyed rang rnams kyi dbu la bkon par bsgoms la/ tshig 'di skad gsung par sgoms shig /rin chen mkha' 'gros dbu rgyan dbang*/ /de ring khyod la bskur bar bya// sangs rgyas yon tan rab bsgrub phyir/ /rin chen mkha' 'gror khyod gyur cig/ oṃ rat+na a bhi ṣiñca hūṃ/ zhes slob dpon gyis brjod kyang ting nge 'dzin gyis rin chen mkha' 'gros brjod par sgoms/ steng gi nam mkha' man sngar dang 'dra/ de ltar rin chen mkha' 'gros dbu rgyan gyi dbang bskur bas/ tshor ba'i phung po rin chen rigs kyi lha tshogs su gyur/ nga rgyal mnyam pa nyid kyi ye shes su gnas gyur/ 'byung ba sa'i lha mo sangs rgyas spyan ma ru dag pa'o/ /de nas nub kyi pad+ma mkha' 'gros gser gyi rdo rje khyod rang gi spyi bor bzhag par bsams la/ pad+ma mkha' 'gros rdo rje'i dbang*/ /de ring khyod la bskur bar bya/ /sangs rgyas gsung ni rab bsgrub phyir/ /pad+ma mkha' 'gror khyod gyur cig /oṃ pad+ma ṭāk+ki a bhi ṣañci hūṃ/ zhes slob dpon gyis brjod kyang pad+ma mkha' 'gros brjod par bsgom/ de ltar pad+ma mkha' 'gros rdo rje'i dbang bskur bas/ 'du shes kyi phung po pad+ma rigs kyi lha tshogs su gnas dag /'dod chags so sor rtog pa'i ye shes 'byung ba me yi lha mo gos dkar mor dag pa'o/ / de nas byang gi las kyi mkha' 'gros/ dngul dkar gyi dril bu khyod rang rnams kyi spyi bor bzhag par bsgoms la/ las kyi mkha' 'gros dril bu'i dbang*/ /de ring khyod la bskur bar bya/ /sangs rgyas phrin las rab bsgrub phyir// las kyi mkha' 'gror khyod gyur cig /oṃ karma ṭāk+ki ni a bhi ṣiñca hūṃ/ zhes slob dpon gyis brjod kyang las kyi mkha' 'gros brjod par sgoms/

des las kyi mkha' 'gros dril bu'i dbang bskur bas/ 'du byed kyi phung po las kyi rigs kyi lha tshogs su gyur/ phrag dog bya ba nan tan gyi ye shes/ 'byung ba rlung*/ dam tshig sgrol mar gnas dag pa'o/ /de nas shar gyi de bzhin rigs kyi mkha' 'gros cod paṇa gsang mtshan dang bcas pa spyi bor bzhag par bsgoms la/ sangs rgyas mkha' 'gros ming gi dbang*/ /de ring khyod la bskur bar bya/ /sangs rgyas sku ni rab bsgrub phyir/ /bde gshegs mkha' 'gror khyod gyur cig /oṃ bhud+dha ṭāk+ki ni a bhi ṣiñca hūṃ/ zhes slob dpon gyis brjod kyang bde gshegs mkha' 'gros brjod par sgoms/ de ltar sangs rgyas mkha' 'gros ming gi dbang bskur bas/ gzugs kyi phung po de bzhin rigs kyi lha tshogs su dag/ gti mug chos dbyings ye shes/ nam mkha' bde gshegs mkha' 'gror gyur/ de rnams ni ma rig pa lnga rig par byed pas na/ thun mong rigs lnga'i dbang bskur zhes bya'o/ /gtso bo bdag po'i dbang bskur ba ni/ mkha' 'gro sde lnga'i thang sku dang sgrub thabs me long rnams bla mas spyi bor bzhag par bsgoms byas la/ tshig 'di skad brjod do/ /sangs rgyas kun gyis byin brlabs pa'i/ /rdo rje mkha' 'gro'i sku gsung thugs/ /blo chen khyod kyis gzung bar bgyi/ /sangs rgyas rnams dang mnyam par 'gyur/ /oṃ badz+ra ṭāk+ki ni ka ya wa ka tsit+ta dha ra hūṃ/ des gtso bos bdag po'i dbang thob pas/ gcod kyi chos skor nyan pa dang 'chad pa dang nyams su len pa la dbang ba yin no bya'o/ /rdo rje slob dpon gyi dbang bskur ni/ ngas khyed rnams kyi phyag g.yas su rdo rje dang*/ g.yon du dril bu gtad/ mgo la dbu rgyan bkon/ mchan khung du kha ṭ+wāṃ ga gtad par sgoms shig byas la/ rdo rje mkha' 'gros legs sbyin pa'i/ /rdo rje slob dpon dbang skur te// rdo rje sems dpa' khyod gyur to/ /slob ma yongs su bsdu bar gyis/

/oṃ badz+ra ṭāk+k-i ni ma hā gu ru hūṃ/ zhes brjod do/ /des ni slob ma'i tshogs bsdus nas gzhan don byed pa la dbang ba'o/ /'bras bu ye shes skyed pa'i mchog dbang gsum bskur ba la/ thog mar gsang dbang bskur ba ni/ phyogs bzhi'i mkha' 'gro ma bzhi dbus kyi gtso mo rdo rje mkha' 'gro ma la thim/ kha ṭ+wām̐ ga yab tu gyur nas yab yum snyoms par zhugs pas thig le dkar dmar/ gtso mo'i bha ga'i nang du babs te/ tshur la 'phros pas khyed rnams kyi lce thog tu byung bar sgoms shig byas la/ slob dpon gyis tshig 'di skad brjod/ sangs rgyas kun gyi sku gsung thugs/ /thabs dang shes rab dbyer med pa'i/ /gsang ba'i gnas nas legs byung zhing*/ /rigs kyi bu la dbang bskur ro/ /oṃ badz+ra nu ra raka tā a mri ta hūṃ/ zhes brjod pas sangs rgyas thams cad thig le dkar dmar gyi rnam par zhu nas rang gi mgrin par thim par sgoms/ de ni gsang dbang ngo*// shes rab ye shes kyi dbang bskur ba ni/ dbusakyi gtso mo pho brang gi dbus nas byon/ skyes pa rnams kyi don du rdo rje mkha' 'gror gyur/ bud med rnams kyi don du rdo rje rigs kyi he ru kar gyur te/ de rang dang zhal sbyar bar sgoms shig byas la/ rdo rje slob dpon gyis 'di skad ces brjod do/ stong nyid snying rje dbyer med pa'i/ /bde chen thabs dang shes rab 'di/ khyod kyis rtag tu brten par gyis// sangs rgyas rnams dang mnyam par 'gyur/ /oṃ badz+ra ma hā su kha shu n+ya ta hūṃ/ zhes snyoms par zhugs pas bde stong dbyer med kyi nyams rgyud la skyes par sgoms/ tshig dbang bskur ba ni/ yum rdo rje rigs kyi mkha' 'gro ma de rang la thim/ dbang bskur mkhan gyi slob dpon yang rang la thim/ rang 'ja' yal ba bzhin du stong pa nyid du gyur/ skur mkhan slob dpon/ dbang bskur len pa'i slob ma/ bskur bya'i dbang thams cad 'khor gsum yongs su dag par sgoms shig byas la/

'di skad bya'o/ /'di ltar 'khor 'das brtan g.yo'i tshogs/ /sgyu 'phrul chen po'i rang bzhin can/ /thams cad chos sku mnyam pa nyid/ /rigs kyi bu khyod dbang bskur ro/ /oṃ sarba dharma swa bha ba shud+dho hūṃ/ zhes brjod pas snang srid 'khor 'das kyis bsdus pa'i chos thams cad rang gi sems kyi cho 'phrul/ dag pa sku gsum gyi ngo bo/ skye med stong pa'i rang bzhin yin snyam du bsam mo/ /de rnams ni dbang bzhi gdan thog gcig tu bskur ba'i cho ga'o/ / de nas bla mar ci 'byor ba'i yon phul/ dbang bzhi rdzogs su gnang ba bka' drin che lags so bya'o/ /de nas tshogs la rol/ rdo rje'i glu blangs/ gar bya/ bro brdung*/ gtor ma dang po de bdud rtsir lngar byin gyis brlabs te bla ma yi dam la phul/ gtor dbang dang dmigs pa gcod gzhan nas bshad pa bzhin bya/ tshogs la rol/ gnyis pa mkha' 'gro la 'bul/ gsum pa chos skyong la/ bzhi pa gzhi bdag dang dkar phyogs skyong ba spyi la 'bul/ de nas gshegs chog bya/ mchod pa bsdu/ dge ba byang chub tu bsngo/ smon lam btab par bya'o/ /gcod kyi sngon 'gro slob ma'i rgyud dag par byed cing zab mo bstan pa'i snod du rung bar byed pa/ dbang bzhi gdan thog gcig tu bskur ba'i cho ga rdzogs so// // ༈ ye shes dbab pa ni/ steng gi nam mkha' la/ ma gcig lab kyi sgron ma brgyud pa'i bla ma rnams dang tha mi dad par sku gcer bur bzhugs pa/ rus pa'i rgyan drug gis brgyan pa/ thod skam gyi dbu rgyan/ mi mgo'i do shal/ phyag g.yas na gser gyi ḍā ma ru stong gsum khyab pa'i sgra sgrogs pa/ g.yon na dngul gyi dril bu 'khrol ba/ mchan khung g.yon na kha ṭ+wāṃ ga bsnams pa zhabs g.yon pa ro'i snying khar mnan pa/ g.yas bskum pa g.yon pa'i brla la gtad pa/ khams gsum zil gyis gnon nus pa'i bdag nyid can/ 'khor mkha' 'gro dpag tu med pas bskor ba/ la las rdo rje'i glu len/

la las rdo rje'i gar byed/ la las rdo rje'i bro 'khrab pa'i dbus na ma cig spyan gsum steng gi nam mkha' la gzigs shing*/ gar stabs su ling ling 'khrab cing 'dug par bsgoms la mos gus dung pa gyis shig byas la/ rdo rje slob dpon bdag gis kyang rig pa skye med kyi ngang nas/ nyams 'gags med kyi ngar dang ldan pas ḍā ma ru dkrol zhing*/ brgyud pa'i bla ma byin rlabs can/ /rtsa ba'i bla ma bka' drin can/ /'dren pa'i bla ma thugs rje can/ /dbang bskur byin gyis brlab tu gsol/ /ces bla ma brgyud pa dang bcas pa la gsol ba drag tu btab la de rnams byon nas slob ma rnams kyi spyi bor thims pas/ slob ma'i lus ngag yid gsum zag med kyi bde ba ru ltem ltem skyes par sgom mo/ / de ltar byas pas/ sku phebs na gar byed 'khrab cing phyag rgya bsgyur ba yong*/ gsung phebs na sngags bzla /rgya skad du smra/ ha ha dang hi hi'i sgra sgrog tuyong*/ thugs phebs na gsal stong 'dzin med kyi nyams bun long ba 'char/ blo bde 'bol ba 'ong*/ nyams dga' ya le ba 'byung ngo*/ /gtor dbang byed na gtor ma che shos de byin gyis brlabs te slob ma rnams kyi spyi bor bzhag la/ 'o gtor ma 'di ma gcig lab kyi sgron ma lang tsho bcu drug lon pa gcer bu rus pa'i rgyan drug gis brgyan pa la sogs pa sngar gyi dmigs pa rnams phog la rang gi spyi bor byon/ snying gar thim par sgoms shig bya'o/ /brgyud pa'i bla ma la gsol ba 'debs pa la brten nas tshogs bsags pa ni/ sgom skye bar byed pa la tshogs bsags shing sgrib pa sbyangs pa zhig dgos te/ sngon 'gro bsags sbyangs ma byas par sgom 'debs pa de snam bu dri ma can tshos su 'tshed pa dang 'dra bas/ sgom gsha' ma skye ru mi 'dod de mdo las/ ji srid dge ba'i rtsa ba ma rdzogs pa/ /de srid stong nyid dam pa thob mi 'gyur/ /zhes gsungs pas/

tshogs bsags pa ni/ yar bla ma dkon mchog la zhabs tog tu ci 'gyur byed pa dang*/ rab sgrub pa'i zhabs tog mos gus dang gsol 'debs bya/ 'bring lus ngag gis yar gong ma'i thugs dgongs ci rdzogs dang*/ rang gi lus ngag yid gsum gyi sdig sgrib ci 'dag gi thabs la 'bad par bya/ tha ma zang zing gi zhabs tog ni yod na dngos su 'bul/ med na yid kyis sprul nas 'bul/ mar sems can la lus ngag yid gsum dang*/ zang zing gi longs spyod kyis phan ci thogs bya/ tshogs ma rdzogs par byin rlabs mi 'byung ste/ rdza grang mo la la mi 'byar ba dang 'dra/ sgrib pa sbyong ba ni/ spyir tshogs bsags pa kho nas sgrib pa 'dag ste/ dge sdig gnyis lhan cig tu mi gnas pa yin/ dper na nam langs pa dang mun pa sangs ba gnyis dang 'dra/ 'on kyang bye brag tu sgrib pa sbyangs na yar gong ma la zhabs tog /mar 'og ma la phan pa ma byung yang rang gi lus ngag yid gsum chos su 'gro ba'i sgo nas/ bzang ngan bya btang dgos pa yin pas/ dka' thub/ dka' spyad/ chu 'thung*/ rde'u 'cha' ba/ gdan gcig don zhags bsrung ba/ phyag dang skor ba byas pas gzhan la ma phan yang rang gi sgrib pa bkres skom dang ngal dub myong bas 'dzad pa yin/ dper na snam bu'i dri ma ma dag na tshos gang rung btsos kyang rang mdog dang kha dog dang mo mi yong ba yin/ de bzhin du rang gi rgyud kyi dri ma ma dag na chos gang gi sgor zhugs kyang*/ bla ma su la'ang sgom zhus na'ang gsha' ma zhig skye ru mi 'dod pas/ lus ngag yid gsum tshogs bsags shing sgrib pa sbyangs ba gnyis la 'bad pa gal che'o/ /de'i rgyu'i gtso bor skyabs 'gro dang gsol 'debs kyi lung 'bogs par bgyi bas/ mdun gyi nam mkha' la yum chen mo man chod kyi rtsa ba dang brgyud pa'i bla ma dang*/ yid dam dpa' bo dang mkha' 'gro sangs rgyas byang chub sems dpa' thams cad sprin 'thibs pa bzhin bzhugs par bsgoms la nga'i lad mo mdzod cig

/bla ma yi dam mkha' 'gro dang*/ /chos sku longs sku sprul sku dang*/ /sangs rgyas chos dang dge 'dun la/ /bdag ni gus pas skyabs su mchi/ /bdag gi rgyud la pha rol tu phyin pa'i chos/ sangs rgyas thams cad kyi dgongs pa/ don dam pa'i bden pa phyin ci ma log pa de dus da lta nyid du skye bar byin brlab tu gsol/ zhes lan gsum bya'o/ / de nas zhag bdun du gsol 'debs sngar gyi tshig bzhi po bskyar gyin 'debs par bya'o/ /nyin mtshan kun tu gsol 'debs dang phyag dang skor ba la 'bad cing*/ spyi las yar ldan/ kun la'ang nus tshad byed pa gal che/ de ltar byas pas sgrib pa zad pa'i rtags blo sna thung ba/ skyo ba skye ba/ dad gus che ba/ 'chi ba dran pa 'byung ngo*/ /rmi lam du'ang khrus byas pa dang*/ skyugs pa dang*/ bshal ba dang*/ nam mkhar 'phur ba dang*/ gos dkar po dang*/ gsar pa dri ma med pa gyon pa la sogs pa rmis pa 'byung ngo*/ /a+thi+-i ༈ rig pa rkyang 'ded la brten nas sems btsal ba ni/ sgom 'debs pa'i sngon du slob mas sems btsal ba gal che ste/ sems kyi phu thag ma bcad par sgom btab kyang mi thebs/ thebs kyang yid ches mi skye ste/ dper na nad pa'i rtsa ma bltas par sman btang ba'am/ 'ben ma mthong bar mda' 'phen pa dang 'dra/ gtad sa zhig dgos pa yin/ de las sems kyi 'tshol lugs 'di ltar bya ste/ 'o na sngon chad khams gsum du 'khor/ rigs drug tu 'khyams/ bde sdug sna tshogs myong ba de/ gang gis lan na/ rang sems 'khrul pas lan pa yin/ da 'khrul pa'i rtsad bcad dgos pas/ blo zhes bya/ rig pa zhes bya/ sems zhes bya/ shes pa rnam rtog ces ming du mar btags kyang don sems gcig pu yin/ de'i ngo bo dang*/ gya gyu mang po/ spra spro/ thal thol/ sprang spring*/ mi dran dgu dran/ rnam rtog sna tshogs su dran pa 'di yin pas/ 'di mi btsal ba'i ka med sgom sems la byed pa yin/ sems rang la yod pas 'di rtsab gdar ma bcad na sgom skye ru mi 'dod/

dper na bzo bo ji ltar bzo mkhas kyang*/ bzo rgyu med pas bzo mi shes/ byan mo ji ltar g.yos mkhas kyang*/ g.yo rgyu med na g.yos mi shes pa yin no/ /de bzhin du bla ma chos mkhas gdams pa zab/ ngo sprod pa gzo na'ang*/ slob mas sems ma btsal bar bla mas ngo sprad mi shes pas/ sems 'tshol dgos pa'i rgyu mtshan bde sdug thams cad kyi rtsa ba sems yin pas kyang btsal dgos/ sangs rgyas sems la byon pas kyang btsal dgos/ slob mas sems ma btsal na bla mas ngo sprad mi shes pas na btsal dgos/ sems de la 'tshol lugs ji ltar du btsal na/ do nub nas bzung nas/ zhag bdun du tshig gsum po 'di nyams su longs shig /sems kyi gnas sa gang na 'dug lta ba/ gzugs ji ltar 'dug lta ba/ kha dog ji ltar 'dug lta ba'o/ /dang po sems mi 'char dgu 'char/ rig pa sna tshogs su 'phro/ sna tshogs su dran pa 'di/ dang po gang nas byung na rang las byung*/ bar du gang du gnas na rang la gnas/ tha ma gang du thims na rang la thims pas/ des na rang gi lus gang po gcig sha gang po las 'os mi 'dug pas/ ya gi spyi gtsug nas/ ma gi rkang pa'i mthil yan chad gang na 'dug tshol/ mgo dang yan lag tu phye nas tshol/ lhu dang rdul du bsil nas tshol/ lpags pa la 'dug gam/ rus pa la 'dug gam/ nang khrol la 'dug gam/ don snying la 'dug gam/ khrag dang chu ser la 'dug gam/ sha dang rgyus pa la 'dug gam/ dbang po lnga la 'dug gam/ mal sa dang 'dug sa la 'dug gam/ gos kyi gseb rnams gang la 'dug ltos/ sems kyi gzugs ji ltar 'dug lta ba ni/ dga' mi dga' bde sdug /skye rga na 'chi la sogs byed mkhan thams cad sems kho rang du 'dug pa la kho'i ngo bo*/ gzugs ci 'dra zhig 'dug ltos/ gru bzhir 'dug gam/ zlum por 'dug gam/ ril bur 'dug gam/ sog khar 'dug gam/ nas 'dra bar 'dug gam/ zur gsum du 'dug gam/ gang du 'dug ltos shig /sems kyi kha dog ci 'dra 'dug lta ba ni/

rnam rtog sna tshogs su 'char/ dran rtog du ma ru 'phro/ rtog tshogs ji snyed cig yong gi 'dug pa des na sems de dngos po yod pa'i rtags yin/ dngos med gcig yin na 'di tsho mi 'char bas/ dngos po yin na kha dog gcig yong bas/ sems kha dog ci 'drar 'dug ltos/ dkar po dang*/ nag po dang*/ ser po dang*/ dmar po dang*/ sngon po dang*/ ljang khu gang du 'dug khra bo dang mthing kha gang du 'dug ltos/ sems la yar lta mar lta gyis/ phu 'ded mda' 'ded gyis/ rig pa rgyang 'ded gyis/ lta nyul dang slong gzhig rem du gyis la ltos dang*/ sems ma rnyed na/ gyur tser 'gyu/ thur tser dran/ thol te skyes pa 'di la ltos/ 'gyu ba de byung tshad kyis ma yengs par 'gyu mkhan de gang du 'dug ltos dang*/ ji ltar 'dug ltos/ bltas pas ma mthong*/ btsal bas ma rnyed na/ chad pa ngal gso ba dang stabs gcig tu lhod de zhog cig / zhag gsum mam bdun du gsol 'debs la sogs pa'i dge sbyor gzhan tsho zhog la/ sems 'tshol ba nyag gcig la dril la nyams su longs/ nyin re bzhin tshig gsum po de gsal 'debs pas nga can du shog cig bya'o/ / nang par nas kyang slob dpon gyis sems 'gyu ba de btsal lam/ rnyed dam ci 'dra 'dug ces dris la sngar bzhin gsal re btab bo/ /zhag rdog gsum po 'di la nga la tshig gsum las bshad rgyu med/ khyod la'ang 'tshol ba min pa bya rgyu med/ ngal ba dang*/ dub pa dang*/ chad pa dang*/ yengs ba dang*/ brjed pa dang*/ gnyid bro ru byung na/ ci la btang ba yin ci la yong ba yin/ 'khor 'das ru shan 'byed dus 'dir dal bar bsdad pa'i skabs med/ sangs rgyas thob par sgom skye dgos par 'dug /sgom skye ba la sems btsal dgos par 'dug

/sems mi 'tshol na yong ma yong med snyam la rang la rang gis gros btab/ blo skyed 'don pa gal che'o/ /sems 'tshol rab la sgom rab/ 'bring la sgom 'bring*/ sems 'tshol tha ma la sgom tha ma skye bas/ 'tshol bar rems la yun gang ring tshad sgom bzang nas yong ba yin no bya'o/ / a+thi+-i / dri med pa'i gcod yul rig 'dzin pad+ma gling pa las thob pa'o/ /dge'o/ / bkris so/ / mes po'i shul bzhag las/ klong chen rab 'byams kyi gsung 'bum/ (26)dbang bskur chos kyi sgo 'byed gcod kyi zhal gdams/ - PAGE 16 -- PAGE 15 -- PAGE 1 -
